import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    return df

def answer(df):
    species_avg = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    overall_avg = df['body_mass_g'].mean()
    result = {'all': overall_avg}
    for species, avg in species_avg.items():
        result[species] = avg
    return result
